newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian central bank sells 297 bln rbls bills. [CORRECTED 11:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Russian central bank sells 297 bln rbls bills. [CORRECTED 11:35 GMT]

text.p: The central bank sold 297.00 billion roubles nominal of GKO discount Treasury bills on behalf of the Finance Ministry on Monday, the bank's open-market operations department said.
(Corrects headline and first paragraph from 214 to 297 billion roubles, taking
The bank made the following transactions:
(Corrects to insert line 21080 83.00 bln roubles after the 21079 T-bill item)

The bank did not say at what price the paper was sold. The 21076 issue closed on Monday at 85.69 percent, the 21078 issue closed at 85.05 percent, the 21079 issue closed at 84.54 percent, the 21080 issue closed at 84.30 percent (corrects to insert 21080 T-bill item) and the 23007 issue closed at 86.80 percent.
Apart from intervening on its own account to smooth liquidity and conduct monetary policy, the central bank buys and sells securities to manage the Finance Ministry's debt and asset portfolio.
